newsitem.title: USA: CIMA LABS in pact with F H Faulding.
newsitem.headline: CIMA LABS in pact with F H Faulding.

text.p: CIMA LABS Inc said Wednesday it had agreed to collaborate with F H Faulding & Co Ltd in developing opportunities to combine CIMA's OraSolv technology with Faulding's modified release technologies, including its taste-masking technology.
Details of the agreement were not disclosed.

"We look forward to exploring the synergy of our technologies and providing value-added drug-delivery systems to our corporate partners," said Dr. John Siebert, CIMA president and chief executive officer, in a statement.
F H Faulding is a diversified Australian healthcare company with annual sales in excess of $1.2 billion. Faulding has developed drug delivery technologies.
